The installed iPhone Home Screen app can make one automatic Microsoft session-recovery navigation at startup when silent authorization requires interaction. It uses `prompt=none` to try an existing Microsoft session without asking for credentials.

Failed or interrupted attempts remain blocked until silent authorization succeeds, you explicitly reconnect, or you sign out. Editing, foreground/network retries, and ordinary background sync never trigger this automatic navigation. Local data and explicit reconnect remain available.

Safari tabs, iPad and desktop behavior are unchanged. Microsoft policies and browser session restrictions may still require explicit reconnection.

No data migration is required.
